caption:
Why would a physio or chiropractor suggest seeing your GP?

Most aches and pains settle with the right movement, load and time. But part of a good assessment is spotting when a doctor's input is needed too, like fever with back pain, unexplained weight loss or night pain that doesn't ease in any position.

Sometimes progress simply stalls, and a GP review can look at the bigger picture. It's never a brush-off. With your consent we can write to your GP and keep working on your plan together.

Our team at Hybrid Physio is happy to talk through next steps. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
